court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Commissioner of Land Administration and Others
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. C. Jayaprakash Government Advocate
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of writ of mandamus, directing the 3rd respondent to dispose the appeal petition dated 31-5-2024 filed by the petitioner within the stipulated period of time for issuing Patta in the name of the petitioner for the land admeasuring an extent of 2.48 acres comprised in Old Survey No. 340/2A, New T.S. No. 85 to 102 Velacherry Village Chennai District, Vijay Nagar of 2nd 3rd and 4th Street within the limit of CMDA and Chennai Corporation.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— This Writ Petition has been filed seeking for a limited relief. The petitioner seeks for an early disposal of his appeal, dated 31-5-2024, pending on the file of the 3rd respondent.

2. Aggrieved by the order of the 4th respondent, the petitioner had preferred an appeal dated 31-5-2024 before the 3rd respondent. Since the same was not disposed of, the petitioner has filed this writ petition.

3. Mr C. Jayaprakash, learned government advocate, accepts notice on behalf of the respondents.

4. No prejudice would be caused to the respondents, if a direction is issued to the 3rd respondent to dispose of the petitioner's appeal, dated 31-5-2024 on merits and in accordance with law, within a time frame to be fixed by this Court, by adhering to the principles of natural justice. This Court is not expressing any opinion on the merits of the petitioner's appeal, dated 31-5-2024.

5. For the foregoing reasons, this Court directs the 3rd respondent to dispose of the petitioner's appeal, dated 31-5-2024 on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of twelve (12) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, by adhering to the principles of natural justice.

6. With the aforesaid direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs.
